topic: Freddie Mac weekly U.S. national average mortgage rates

source.name: Freddie Mac Primary Mortgage Market Survey (PMMS)
source.limitations: Weekly survey averages; not daily rates, APRs, or borrower-specific quotes.

writer_summary: Freddie Mac’s October 1, 2026, weekly survey reported U.S. average mortgage rates of 7.28% for a 30-year fixed loan and 6.60% for a 15-year fixed loan. Compared with the September 24 release, the 30-year average rose 0.25 percentage points (25 basis points), while the 15-year average rose 0.18 points (18 basis points). The gap between the two terms widened from 0.61 to 0.68 percentage points. The October 1 release covers the survey period September 24–30. These figures are weekly survey averages, not daily rates, APRs, or a quote for an individual borrower. Source: Freddie Mac Primary Mortgage Market Survey, https://www.freddiemac.com/pmms.
